name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in mid-2026 and received environmental permits from both provincial governments, transitioning from explorer to developer with a Final Investment Decision targeted for 2027 and first production by end of 2029.
